desc:
Welcome to Flip Rocks for Brainrot! 🗿

How many Brainrots can you FIND? Keep flipping rocks to discover the rarest ones out there! 🤯

1. Flip rocks to uncover hidden Brainrots 🤫
2. Escape the Players that try to grab your Brainrots 😱😡
3. Bring them back to your base to earn money 💵

🧠 Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

👍 Like the game & join the group!
